criteria.criterion: DET caused_by floor blocks epic close with an open/in_progress caused_by bug in the subtree, with a teaching message (fix / re-parent / dispute link).
Candidate filter implements exactly: open|in_progress bugs AND (created-after-first-in_progress OR linked-any-relation-any-depth); commit-relation is NOT implemented.
Screen rides model-class config + shared cache settings (no hand-built client), forced-choice output with citation, parallel after cache warm.
Verifier receives at most 8 compact candidates (title+citation+id) + overflow count inside the precheck-assembled fenced context (verified by a forwarding unit test on the assembled string).

Verifier adjudicates via show_ticket on demand and blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects per the store-grounded disposition rule — (a) supersedes/duplicates link, or (b) reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose; never close_class (verified by the must-block/must-pass regression fixtures).
Screen verdict rides a registered output schema + normalizing validator (overlap_verdict idiom); verifier directive text lands in completion_verifier.md.
Screen tally recorded in the completion sidecar, including the unevaluated-overflow count when the 32-candidate screen ceiling truncates; screen failure degrades open with a logged reason.
Full regression set above encoded as tests (must-block, must-pass, not-flagged).

docs/plan-review-gate.md close-gate section documents the three-stage gate (DET floor, candidate filter, screen + disposition rule) and docs/llm-framework.md references the epic_bug_screen prompt/schema.
